about: Kept by esv::inventory::SummoningSystem (ProcessReequipUpdates, game bg3.exe+0x35087A0 ~ Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xF2AB60): remembers what was unequipped when a summoned item took an equipment slot, so it can be re-equipped when the summon goes away. A HashMap<EntityHandle, Array<esv::inventory::UnequippedEntry>> (macOS names: ls::HashMap<ls::ID<ecs::EntityHandleTraits>, ls::DynamicArray<esv::inventory::UnequippedEntry>>). Saved (model game.inventory.v0.ReequipStackComponent, 16 bytes; member names not in the macOS symbols). Never seen alive. Registry total 64 (server row).

evidence.says: Storage registration bg3.exe+0x2702560: size 0x40, destructor bg3.exe+0x591CF0 (frees the value array at +0x30, then the 48-byte HashSet of keys via bg3.exe+0x582AD0). Game bg3.exe+0x35087A0 walks it as a HashMap: keys at +0x20 with count at +0x2C, values at +0x30 with stride 0x10 (the key index times 0x10 added to the values pointer), each value an Array of 0x28-byte entries. Key and value types from the macOS template name ls::HashMap<ls::ID<ecs::EntityHandleTraits>, ls::DynamicArray<esv::inventory::UnequippedEntry>>.

survey.live_reason: no live or captured instance: needs a situation that creates it
open_questions: Entry member names are inferred; which slot enum the two slot bytes use (0x16 = none) and why an entry holds two slot/item pairs (main hand / off hand?) is not established.
Savegame model game.inventory.v0.ReequipStackComponent (16 bytes) has no member names in the macOS symbols.
Not seen alive (seen.py has no samples).

fields.name: Slot
fields.evidence: Game bg3.exe+0x35087A0 line 435 tests whether the byte at +0 of the entry is not 0x16 (0x16 = no slot) and passes the byte as the slot to eoc::equipment::GetEquipmentEntityInSlot; Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xF2AB60 line ~538 the same. Equipment slot enum, 1 byte.

fields.name: Item
fields.evidence: game line 436 takes entry +8 (addressed 0x20 bytes before its loop cursor) and it is looked up as an entity and its owner compared with the stack's entity; the entry is filled from the 0x38-byte ReequipStackUpdate (lines 576-586, qword copies to +0/+8).

fields.name: Slot2
fields.evidence: game line 448 tests whether the byte at +0x10 of the entry is not 0x16 - a second slot, same 0x16 = none.

fields.name: Item2
fields.evidence: game line 449 takes entry +0x18 - the second entity, looked up like +8.

fields.name: Processed
fields.evidence: game line 431 writes 1 to the byte at entry +0x20 for every entry visited; Toolkit removes entries whose byte at +0x20 is non-zero (line ~798) with the DynamicArray<esv::inventory::UnequippedEntry> remover.
